summary.text: Nick Fierro is an independent candidate for Arizona State Senate District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Republican David Farnsworth and Democrat Blair Moses.

paragraphs.text: Nick Fierro ran for the same seat in 2022 as an independent and received 38.9 percent of the vote in the general election, against 61.1 percent for Republican David Farnsworth.
In 2020 he was a write-in independent candidate for Arizona State Senate District 16, receiving 1.5 percent of the vote.
